title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Islamabad – Full-Payment Plots & Master Plan
description: Compare Faisal Town Phase 2 full-payment plots, prices and sector plans. Ask about possible K Block options for 10 marla and above.
intro: Our available plots are offered on full payment. Limited installment options may be available in K Block for 10 marla and above only, subject to confirmation on WhatsApp.
body:
## Full-payment Model Blocks: O, P, Q and R

Sector O, Sector P, Sector Q and Sector R are currently the Phase 2 model blocks offered on a full-payment basis. Sector P / The Caladan has its own premium price plan; Sector O, Q and R currently use the shared cash price references from 8 Marla upward.

If you want a model block, choose the sector first and ask for the exact available plot number and final cash payable amount.

## Current payment availability

Our available plots are offered on full payment. Limited installment options may be available in K Block for 10 marla and above only, subject to confirmation on WhatsApp. Sector S and Sector T are offered on full payment only.

## Current price context

Sector T lump-sum prices are 5.56 Marla at PKR 27.90 Lac, 8 Marla at PKR 37.30 Lac, 10.89 Marla at PKR 48.50 Lac, 14.22 Marla at PKR 60.60 Lac and 1 Kanal at PKR 81.20 Lac. Sector P / The Caladan uses its own separate full-payment premium price plan.

For Sector O, Q and R, the current active entry is 8 Marla at PKR 37.30 Lac. Always confirm the exact plot and total payable amount before payment.

## Overseas, W and X on the plan

Overseas, W and X appear on the master plan. Explore available options in Ring Road Block and Sectors O, P, Q, R, S and T.

## Use the right plan

The full Phase 2 master plan is for project-wide orientation. Dedicated plans are now available on this site for Sector O, P, Q, R, S and T. Use the sector plan for plot-level checking and the full master plan for understanding how sectors relate to each other.

## Before you make a payment

Confirm the exact property, cash or installment status, payment schedule where applicable, dues, special-location charges, payment recipient and receipt process. Use current written information for the exact plot.

## Ring Road Block

The Ring Road Block price plan lists five sizes from 5.56 Marla to 1 Kanal, with discounted full-payment prices from PKR 27.90 Lac. [Review the Ring Road Block rates and verification notes](/faisal-town-ring-road-block/). Confirm the exact plot and current block layout separately.
